name: MR Muavia MD BOT
description: MR Muavia MD BOT - WhatsApp Automation Bot with Baileys, AI, downloaders and Islamic auto-posting.

OWNER_NAME.description: Owner display name shown in the menu/footer.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner WhatsApp number in international format, no + or spaces (e.g. 923001234567).

OWNER_DISPLAY_NUMBER.description: Owner number in local display format.

WELCOME_MESSAGE.description: Welcome line shown in the .menu output.

LOGO_URL.description: Bot logo/branding image URL used in the menu.

CHANNEL_URL.description: Public WhatsApp channel invite link shown in the menu.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional - only needed to deliver pairing codes via a Telegram bot.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional - required only for the .ai command to work.

AI_MODEL.description: Model name used by the .ai command.

GIPHY_API_KEY.description: Optional - has a public fallback key if left blank.

DEFAULT_CITY.description: Default city for Islamic prayer-time reminders.

DEFAULT_COUNTRY.description: Default country for Islamic prayer-time reminders.

DEFAULT_TIMEZONE.description: Default IANA timezone for Islamic scheduling.

APP_URL.description: Public URL of this deployed instance, used only for the built-in anti-sleep ping. Set this to your Heroku app URL after the first deploy.
